description.en: Changes the background music track playing for the current map.
Name/ID of the BGM track to play, e.g. "M_07".
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Switch the map's background music
CMND_SET_MAP_BGM("M_07");
